title: About Us
content: Learn more about our resort, our values, and our commitment to sustainable tourism in Matheran.
meta_description: Learn about our eco-friendly resort in Matheran, our commitment to sustainable tourism, and our passion for providing unforgettable experiences.
subtitle: Where time slows down and nature whispers its ancient secrets. Welcome to Horseland Hotel.

items.name: Sachin Dabhekar
items.description: With a keen eye for detail and a passion for hospitality, Sachin ensures that every corner of Horseland runs smoothly. From operations to guest experience, he blends leadership and warmth to make every stay truly memorable.

items.name: Mahesh Patel
items.description: The face of Horseland’s hospitality, Mahesh, welcomes each guest with genuine warmth. He and his team make every arrival effortless, ensuring comfort, clarity, and care from check-in to farewell

items.name: Tushar Biramnae
items.description: The Front Office Receptionist is the welcoming beacon of our hotel, radiating warmth and efficiency. With a knack for turning queries into solutions, they're the first friendly face ensuring your stay is nothing short of delightful.

items.name: Nitin Sawant
items.description: Our meticulous Accountant balances the books with the precision of a tightrope walker and the flair of a financial wizard. They ensure every penny finds its purpose, making sure our numbers always add up to success (and maybe a little extra magic).

items.name: Siddesh Ghag
items.description: The Housekeeping Supervisor is a champion of cleanliness, ensuring every nook and cranny whispers perfection. They're the meticulous guardian of guest comfort, making sure every stay feels like a fresh start.

team.quote: Together, we don't just work at Horseland—we live and breathe its values, creating a home away from home for every guest who walks through our doors.
team.heading: The Heart of Horseland
team.description: Our dedicated team brings together decades of hospitality experience, local expertise, and a shared passion for creating unforgettable experiences.

legacy.heading: A Legacy of Hospitality
legacy.paragraph1: Since our founding in 2001, Horseland has been a sanctuary for those seeking respite from urban life. Nestled in the pristine hills of Matheran, we've cultivated an experience that honors both heritage and sustainability.
legacy.paragraph2: Our commitment to eco-conscious hospitality and authentic wellness has made us a cherished destination for families, couples, and conscious travelers from around the world.

founder.bio1: A visionary hotelier with over 24 years of experience in sustainable tourism, Adi founded Horseland in 2001 with a simple dream: to create a sanctuary where guests could reconnect with nature without compromising on comfort.
founder.bio2: His passion for eco-conscious hospitality and deep respect for Matheran's natural heritage has shaped every aspect of Horseland's philosophy. Under his leadership, the hotel has become a pioneering example of sustainable comfort in India's hospitality industry.
founder.name: Adi Bharucha
founder.quote: Hospitality is not just about providing comfort—it's about creating memories that last a lifetime while preserving the beauty that surrounds us.
founder.heading: Meet Our Founder

feature1.title: Vehicle-Free Zone
feature1.description: Pure air, peaceful walks, and the symphony of nature undisturbed by engines.

feature2.title: Red Mud Trails
feature2.description: Distinctive rust-colored paths that lead to breathtaking viewpoints and hidden groves.

feature3.title: Forest Living
feature3.description: Immerse yourself in nature where ancient trees create natural sanctuaries of calm.

matheran.description: India's only vehicle-free hill station, where red mud trails wind through ancient forests and clean mountain air fills your lungs.
